file.reason: insert_drive_file is the standard generic file icon in Material Symbols (a page with a corner fold).

document.reason: description shows a document with text lines, matching the 'text document' concept.

pdf.reason: picture_as_pdf is the dedicated PDF icon in Material Symbols.

new-folder.reason: create_new_folder shows a folder with a plus sign.

open-folder.reason: Direct match for an open folder.

archive.reason: Direct match. Shows a box/archive container.

zip.reason: folder_zip shows a folder with a zipper, representing compressed files.

attachment.reason: attach_file shows a paperclip for file attachment.

link.reason: Direct match. Shows chain links for URL/hyperlink.

unlink.reason: link_off shows broken chain links, representing unlinking.

image.reason: Direct match. Shows a landscape photo icon.

gallery.reason: collections shows stacked images, representing a photo gallery.

video.reason: videocam shows a video camera, the standard video icon in Material Symbols.

camera.reason: photo_camera is the standard camera icon for photo capture.

volume.reason: volume_up shows a speaker with sound waves, representing volume on/high.

volume-low.reason: volume_down shows a speaker with reduced sound waves.

mute.reason: volume_off shows a speaker with an X, representing muted audio.

music.reason: music_note shows a single musical note.

microphone.reason: mic is the standard microphone icon in Material Symbols.

podcast.reason: podcasts shows concentric arcs representing a podcast signal.

broadcast.reason: cell_tower shows a broadcasting tower with signal waves, fitting the broadcast/live concept.

crop.reason: Direct match. Shows crop marks for image cropping.

rotate.reason: rotate_right shows a circular arrow indicating rotation. Chose right over left as the default rotation direction.

play.reason: play_arrow is the standard play triangle in Material Symbols.

pause.reason: Direct match. Shows two vertical bars.

stop.reason: Direct match. Shows a filled square.

skip-next.reason: Direct match. Shows a triangle with a vertical bar (next track).

skip-previous.reason: Direct match. Shows a vertical bar with a triangle (previous track).

fast-forward.reason: Direct match. Shows double right-pointing triangles.

rewind.reason: fast_rewind shows double left-pointing triangles for rewind.

record.reason: fiber_manual_record is a filled circle, the universal record symbol. Material Symbols does not have a dedicated 'record' icon with a better name.

brush.reason: Direct match. Shows a paint brush.

pen.reason: edit shows a pencil/pen icon, which is the standard drawing/writing tool in Material Symbols. The 'draw' icon also exists but 'edit' is more recognizable as a pen.

color.reason: colorize shows an eyedropper tool for color picking.

eraser.reason: Material Symbols does not have a dedicated eraser icon. The closest alternatives (backspace, clear, delete) represent different concepts entirely and would be misleading as an eraser tool.
